author: adramelekh.
content:
vibe/vibe Testnet Rewards

vibe/vibe Testnet rewards are 5.00% of the total token supply, subject to eligibility checks, anti-abuse review, final review, and team discretion.

> **Reward tracks:**
>   - Traders / users: 1.75%
>   - Meme / artcoin projects: 1.50%
>   - Utility projects: 1.50%
>     - includes RWA and vibecoded/product projects
>     - exact split between RWA and vibecoded/product projects is TBD
>   - Old testnet project creators: 0.25%

Nothing is guaranteed. Joining Discord, launching a project, trading, joining a guild, receiving a role, or being active in the community does not guarantee allocation, NFTs, mainnet support, or any specific reward.

> **  For projects:**
>   - launching on vibevibe testnet is the normal project intake path,
>   - meme/artcoin projects should show real culture, content, or community effort,
>   - utility/RWA/vibecoded projects should have an MVP, demo, prototype, simulation, or usable flow,
>   - ideas alone are not enough for project reward consideration.
> 
> **  For traders/users:**
>   - real testnet activity may be considered,
>   - activity may be reviewed using multiple signals,
>   - fake volume, self-trading, circular trading, sybil activity, spam launches, fake guild activity, impersonation, scam links, or other manipulation may reduce or remove eligibility.

Guild leaders, BD members, moderators, and community members cannot promise rewards or priority. Final eligibility, rankings, reductions, exclusions, and any reward decisions remain subject to team review.

Exact anti-abuse methods, thresholds, caps, formulas, and final criteria will not be public in order to protect the integrity of the testnet.

Use official vibevibe links only. Do not trust DMs, fake forms, copied links, or anyone claiming they can guarantee rewards.
